entities.name: Tokugawa Ieyasu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Founder of the Tokugawa Shogunate (1543–1616), which ruled Japan for over 250 years. He unified Japan after decades of civil war, established Edo (Tokyo) as capital, and implemented policies of isolation (sakoku) that shaped Japanese society until the 19th century.
